description: A retired civil servant (pensiunan PNS) in Yogyakarta received a phone call from a number spoofed to display as the official Bank Indonesia hotline (021-131). The caller, speaking in formal Javanese-accented Indonesian, claimed the victim's account was flagged for suspicious activity and would be frozen unless they immediately transferred funds to a 'safe account' (rekening aman) for 'temporary safekeeping'. Under pressure, the victim made three transfers via ATM totaling IDR 78,000,000 to an account the fraudster claimed belonged to 'OJK-authorized security'. The victim was instructed not to tell anyone including bank staff, citing 'ongoing investigation secrecy'. The receiving account had been opened 3 days prior and withdrew cash via ATM in Semarang within 30 minutes of each transfer.
